verdict.rationale: GitLab's REST API docs say it can control user access to keep permissions consistent across an organization. That is a direct but thin mention of organization-wide access control. Nothing in the pack shows granular permissions at the project, repository, branch, or environment level. Agent-tool Allow/Ask/Deny policies and group-level Agent Platform toggles are adjacent features and earn no credit. Missing for 10: documented project/repository-level roles, protected-branch permissions, protected-environment or deployment permissions, documented role granularity, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can assign granular permissions at organization, project, repository, branch, and environment level

citations.quote: Control user access programmatically to maintain consistent permissions across your organization.
